From: Elena Morales <elena@fastretail.io>

Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & next steps (latency / throughput)

Thanks for the recap, Rishi — good call. A couple of quick questions before we hop to an SE call: 

1) Can you share p50/p95 numbers for 512 / 1024 / 2048 tokens? We are interested in 50-token response tails and worst-case 2k-token responses.
2) How does your KV cache behave for concurrent sessions when model is sharded across GPUs? We need to understand memory/per-req impact.
3) Are the reported numbers measured with quantized weights (int8) or fp16?

I attached our perf requirements sheet so you can see expected QPS by region. If you can send an initial report, I’ll check with infra and we can schedule the SE session.

Attachment: fastretail-reqs-50p95.xlsx

—Elena
Senior Engineering Manager, FastRetail
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@fastretail.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & next steps (latency / throughput)

Elena — thanks, attached is a short perf snapshot we ran against a configuration that approximates your distribution. High level answers up front:

- p50 / p95 (sim): 512 tokens -> p50 48ms, p95 92ms; 1024 tokens -> p50 85ms, p95 180ms; 2048 tokens -> p50 160ms, p95 370ms.
- Cache behavior: KV cache is sharded but we keep per-session KV pointers with cross-GPU routing; we saw ~12–15% throughput drop when cache misses caused cross-GPU fetches in synthetic worst-case.
- Precision: the sim results above are for fp16 runtime; int8 quant (AMPQ) will add ~1.15x latency at p95 for long sequences but reduce GPU memory by ~30%.

Attachment: redwood-latency-sim-8k-quant.pdf (short PDF with the table and run config)

If useful, Monica can schedule a focused 20-min perf run with our SE to reproduce with your exact QPS and model size. Two proposed slots: Tue 24 Feb 09:00 PT or Wed 25 Feb 11:30 PT. Which works?

Best,
Rishi

- Output a short runbook with the model config we tested.

I proposed Tue 24 / Wed 25 slots; if SE can do either I’ll confirm with Elena.
